docs.description:
Event Row — single row representing one audit event in an activity feed.

Use inside Activity Feed (⊞ Patterns / Data) or composed directly into product pages. Anatomy: leading slot (Avatar for user-initiated, Icon for system/device) · title line · meta line (Product tag + context) · trailing timestamp. Expanded density adds a second meta line for device telemetry (dB, channels, gain, preset bank, latency).

Keywords: activity, feed, event, audit, log, history, notification

rules.reason: Bespoke on both: a row of the card family (shells/card.mjs), one event of an activity feed, drawn from Figma's layers, its leading Avatar the caller's and its More a menu of its own; pressable where it is given something to do, its title then the stretched action (owner decision 2026-09-25), hovered and focused only then, as its description says.
Same value, governed token; the More icon's height is already bound to it.
As its width, the leading Avatar's own.
The leading slot holds the caller's Avatar (md, 32px) or icon, whose size is its own: the row places it and never sizes it.

Figma's focused row fills its meta line white (#ffffff, bound to nothing) and draws no focus ring: a stray fill, unseen on the row's own white, where its description asks for a 2px ring (shadow/focus/default). The code draws no fill there, and the ring below; the design review lists it.
The focused row draws SOLAR's focus ring, as its description asks ("a 2px focus ring via shadow/focus/default") and Figma does not draw; the design review asks SOLAR to draw it.

Figma draws one density, default; the expanded one its description names (a second meta line for device telemetry) is not drawn. An axis of one value is no choice: the API loses it, and gains it when SOLAR draws the other.
